title: Inclusive Cities
spatialUnit: Shared 300 m cells in a city-wide latitude-adjusted metric grid. Each original source centre is assigned wholly to one aggregate cell; exported bounds share identical edges. Ground size is approximate.
scope: All place categories and observations combined.

segregation.method: Shared thresholds retained from the original 14-city, both-mode matched-cell calibration.
Shared thresholds retained from the original 14-city, both-mode matched-cell calibration.

distance.method: Seven 0.05 intervals below 0.35; class 7 includes all scores at or above 0.35.

univariateSegregation.method: Seven 0.05 intervals below 0.35; class 7 includes all scores at or above 0.35.

classEncoding: Segregation and distance fields contain only 0–7: classes 0–6 cover successive 0.05 intervals; class 7 includes all scores at or above 0.35. Bivariate fields contain 0–4. Null means unavailable or suppressed; equality at a break enters the higher class.

metrics.segregation: sum(abs(place share - city mode share)) / (2 * (1 - min(city mode share)))

cityMeans: Unweighted means of full-precision eligible aggregate-cell scores, rounded to six decimals. Matched means use both-mode eligible cells.
suppression: A mode/profile class is omitted below 50 cumulative valid UV activity units. Distances require both modes. This is not a threshold on distinct people, records, or each demographic group.
privacyNote: Aggregate 300 m bounds and colour intervals are downloadable. Exact cell scores, source identifiers, activity counts, compositions and city group shares are omitted. This is not formal anonymization.
